studies.title: Rubber
studies.caption: A cut in a rubber tree's bark releases milky latex. Collecting that liquid connected tropical forests with a rapidly growing demand for elastic material.
studies.prompt: Close vertical trunk detail of Hevea brasiliensis with one shallow diagonal tapping cut, a small plain cup tied below collecting a thin white latex trail, trifoliate leaves on nearby branch. Amazonian plantation edge, no blood-like sap, no huge gashes, no worker or modern machinery.
